items.title: Android’s DIY widgets are a bit of vibe-coding fun
items.summary: Aside from dealing with my calendar, there's one thing I want AI to do: tell me if I'm about to miss the bus. What I need is a widget. It needs to tell me real-time arrivals for the bus stop near my house. Tapping around on my phone screen to open the right app and […]
items.author: Allison Johnson
